# jaff.plotting

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Spec-driven, publication-style plotting for JAFF.

See `plot` for the figure-spec format, and `plot_rates` /
`plot_xsecs` for reaction plots.

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`FigureSpec`](figurespec/index.md) | A whole figure: grid shape, row-major axes, theme and legend policy. |
| [`AxesSpec`](axesspec/index.md) | One panel: its series plus scale, limits, labels, tag and legend mode. |
| [`SeriesSpec`](seriesspec/index.md) | One curve (or set of band bars) on an axes. |

## Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`plot`](plot.md) | Render a figure spec; optionally save and show it. |
| [`plot_rates`](plot_rates.md) | Plot rate coefficients against temperature. |
| [`plot_xsecs`](plot_xsecs.md) | Plot photo cross sections against photon energy (or wavelength). |
| [`render`](render.md) | Draw *spec* and return `(fig, axes)`. |
| [`register_style`](register_style.md) | Register a named style built from a partial dict (see `resolve_style`). |
| [`register_palette`](register_palette.md) | Register a named palette from a colour list or label -> colour dict. |
